#!/bin/bash
# Exhaustive static call-site counter for symbols declared under internal/
ROOT=/bench/repo
MODULE=github.com/usememos/memos

tmpdefs=$(mktemp)
tmpimports=$(mktemp)

# Collect definitions
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [[ "$f" == *"_test.go" ]] && continue
  pkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$f" | awk '{print $2}')
  line=0
  while IFS= read -r ln; do
    ((line++))
    if [[ "$ln" =~ ^func\ \(([^)]*)\)\ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\( ]]; then
      recv="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
      recv=$(echo "$recv" | sed 's/^\*//' | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d ' ')
      echo "$pkgpath|$recv|$name|$f|$line|$pkg" >> "$tmpdefs"
    elif [[ "$ln" =~ ^func\ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\( ]]; then
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "$pkgpath||$name|$f|$line|$pkg" >> "$tmpdefs"
    fi
  done < "$f"
done < <(find "$ROOT/internal" -name '*.go' -type f)

# Count call sites for each def
while IFS='|' read -r pkgpath recv name deffile defline pkg; do
  [[ "$name" == "init" ]] && continue
  total=0
  
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    content=$(sed 's|//.*||g' "$f")
    
  if [[ -z "$recv" ]]; then
    # package func
    if [[ "$f" == *"/internal/"* ]]; then
      fpkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
      if [[ "$fpkgpath" == "$pkgpath" ]]; then
        # unqualified same package
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "(^|[^.[:alnum:]_])${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      fi
    fi
    # first char uppercase = exported
    if [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then
      leaf=$(basename "$pkgpath")
      # default import alias = leaf package name
      n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\b${leaf}\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
      total=$((total + n))
      # check custom import aliases from file
      while IFS= read -r alias; do
        [[ -z "$alias" ]] && continue
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\b${alias}\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      done < <(grep -E "\"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/.*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)[[:space:]]+"'"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}"'".*/\1/' | grep -v '^"')
    fi
  else
    # method
    fpkgpath=""
    [[ "$f" == *"/internal/"* ]] && fpkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
    if [[ "$fpkgpath" == "$pkgpath" ]]; then
      n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
      total=$((total + n))
    elif [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then
      # cross-package exported method: count if package imported
      if grep -q "\"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      fi
    fi
  fi
  done < <(find "$ROOT" -name '*.go' -type f)
  
  # subtract 1 if definition line matches (approximate)
  if grep -qE "^func.*${name}\s*\(" "$deffile" 2>/dev/null; then
    ((total--)) 
  fi
  if (( total > 0 )); then
    qual="$pkgpath"
    [[ -n "$recv" ]] && qual="$pkgpath.(*$recv)"
    qual="$qual.$name"
    echo "$total $qual $deffile:$defline"
  fi
done < "$tmpdefs" | sort -rn | head -40

rm -f "$tmpdefs" "$tmpimports"

#!/bin/bash
# Exhaustive static call-site counter for symbols declared under internal/
ROOT=/bench/repo
MODULE=github.com/usememos/memos

tmpdefs=$(mktemp)
tmpimports=$(mktemp)

# Collect definitions
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [[ "$f" == *"_test.go" ]] && continue
  pkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$f" | awk '{print $2}')
  line=0
  while IFS= read -r ln; do
    ((line++))
    if [[ "$ln" =~ ^func\ \(([^)]*)\)\ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\( ]]; then
      recv="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
      recv=$(echo "$recv" | sed 's/^\*//' | awk '{print $NF}' | tr -d ' ')
      echo "$pkgpath|$recv|$name|$f|$line|$pkg" >> "$tmpdefs"
    elif [[ "$ln" =~ ^func\ ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\( ]]; then
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "$pkgpath||$name|$f|$line|$pkg" >> "$tmpdefs"
    fi
  done < "$f"
done < <(find "$ROOT/internal" -name '*.go' -type f)

# Count call sites for each def
while IFS='|' read -r pkgpath recv name deffile defline pkg; do
  [[ "$name" == "init" ]] && continue
  total=0
  
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    content=$(sed 's|//.*||g' "$f")
    
  if [[ -z "$recv" ]]; then
    # package func
    if [[ "$f" == *"/internal/"* ]]; then
      fpkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
      if [[ "$fpkgpath" == "$pkgpath" ]]; then
        # unqualified same package
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "(^|[^.[:alnum:]_])${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      fi
    fi
    # first char uppercase = exported
    if [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then
      leaf=$(basename "$pkgpath")
      # default import alias = leaf package name
      n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\b${leaf}\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
      total=$((total + n))
      # check custom import aliases from file
      while IFS= read -r alias; do
        [[ -z "$alias" ]] && continue
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\b${alias}\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      done < <(grep -E "\"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/.*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)[[:space:]]+"'"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}"'".*/\1/' | grep -v '^"')
    fi
  else
    # method
    fpkgpath=""
    [[ "$f" == *"/internal/"* ]] && fpkgpath=$(echo "$f" | sed "s|^$ROOT/||" | sed 's|/[^/]*$||')
    if [[ "$fpkgpath" == "$pkgpath" ]]; then
      n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
      total=$((total + n))
    elif [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then
      # cross-package exported method: count if package imported
      if grep -q "\"${MODULE}/${pkgpath}\"" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
        n=$(echo "$content" | grep -oE "\.${name}\s*\(" | wc -l)
        total=$((total + n))
      fi
    fi
  fi
  done < <(find "$ROOT" -name '*.go' -type f)
  
  # subtract 1 if definition line matches (approximate)
  if grep -qE "^func.*${name}\s*\(" "$deffile" 2>/dev/null; then
    ((total--)) 
  fi
  if (( total > 0 )); then
    qual="$pkgpath"
    [[ -n "$recv" ]] && qual="$pkgpath.(*$recv)"
    qual="$qual.$name"
    echo "$total $qual $deffile:$defline"
  fi
done < "$tmpdefs" | sort -rn | head -40

rm -f "$tmpdefs" "$tmpimports"
